reviewerIdentity.supplementalScope: Menu-full four viewports, menu-share six viewports; supplemental reviewer authored the earlier combo UI and is not represented as an independent design approval.

reviewedChanges.sourceState: Final frozen working tree based on sourceHead with pending lazy-helper, entry bundling and unchanged analytics coalescing fixes. Exact file identity is the contentBindings map, not sourceHead alone.
reviewedChanges.baselineState: Exact clean committed base worktree, no source replacement or baseline update. Its committed emitted assets were served directly.
reviewedChanges.summary: The final frozen bundle produced 43 complete comparisons: 21 failures and 22 passes, with all 21 failing comparison metrics and dimensions identical to both earlier reviewed captures. One already-passing hero360 comparison improves from 105 differing pixels to 0; the other 42 comparison rows are identical. Every failing comparison was visually inspected. Full-page dimension differences are consistent with the new authored combo entry sections and expanded menu introduction; existing product/photo/price/action/footer structures remain represented in the sampled views. Existing social/share/map/menu-preview crops retain content and controls with small paint or one-pixel crop differences. No new blocking visual defect was observed. Minor zero-gap manual-help border adjacency is disclosed below. This is assistant visual inspection of exact final frozen working-tree blobs, not a claim that clean sourceHead, a later commit, the whole CI job or the live deployment was tested. Global capture budgets, scenarios, browser lock and verifier are unchanged.

repeatEvidence.rawVariationReview: For the two earlier reviewed attempts, all43 comparison metrics and dimensions are identical despite eight nonidentical raw PNG pairs. Every changed region of those eight pairs was inspected: small language/control glyphs, gallery SET-arrow glyphs, map badge glyph and fixed mobile dock paint retain their content. The final rerun has the same21 failing metrics/dimensions; only one already-passing hero360 metric improves from105 pixels to0. Final differing PNG regions were separately inspected as recorded in finalRepeatRawComparison.

sourceTransition.description: After the first two reviewed runs, unchanged lazy-entry/search-clear/analytics behavior was coalesced into existing app/menu bundles to meet the existing transfer budget. Source/script references changed; all CSS and visible page content stayed the same. The final complete capture rerun is bound to the final blob map. An intermediate attempt3 is not used as final-source evidence because another bundling change was announced during that phase.

finalRepeatRawComparison.visualInspection: All eight nonidentical PNG pairs against attempt2 were visually inspected around every changed row group. Variations remain in language/control glyphs, the existing gallery SET arrow, the fixed mobile dock, and menu search/cart control paint. No new content disappearance, clipping or layout harm was observed; no rendering cause is claimed.

inspection.method: Baseline/current raw PNGs and native-browser display sheets were viewed. Primary reviewer inspected all failing comparison types and viewports; supplemental reviewer inspected full-menu top/middle/bottom with registration by observed height delta and all six share states. Long pages were reviewed using overview and selected top/body/footer bands, not OCR or a guarantee for every product pixel.

landingFull.finding: New cream entry section contains three separate routes for together/to-go/kids and native manual help. Its insertion increases page height. Hero/logo/language controls, featured product images, category section, map/social offer and footer remain represented; sampled views show no new overlap or cropped action.

menuFull.finding: One kids link becomes three menu entry links plus manual help. They wrap at narrower widths; the introduction becomes taller. Catalog grids, existing item names/prices/images, share block and footer remain represented below the shifted introduction. No new clipping or obscured catalog controls were observed.

discoverFull.finding: New entry section follows the existing pairing card before the explanatory principles. Three routes stack on narrower viewports and occupy one row on desktop. Existing pairing photo/title/actions, next-pairing price and principles/footer remain represented with no new clipped text or action.

existingComponents.socialOffer: All five failing social-offer comparisons were viewed. Lotus Cheesecake + Latte, 370 price and Instagram action remain visible. Four failures are one-pixel crop-height changes; phone320 shows small border/glyph/paint displacement with matching dimensions. The social-offer source/style bytes are unchanged against the baseline. No claim of a measured business impact or fully proved rendering cause is made.
existingComponents.menuShare: Both failing share states (360-short and 390) retain the heading, copy, share, Instagram and Google Maps actions. Differences are small glyph/border paint shifts with matching dimensions. All six share comparisons received supplemental visual inspection.
existingComponents.menuPreview: 390 crop differs by one pixel in height; six category cards, labels and existing fixed mobile dock remain present. The dock was restored to its original DOM location before freeze.
existingComponents.visitMap: 390 crop retains address, opening hours, Instagram and map actions with matching dimensions. The sticky site header overlaps the top of this selector screenshot in BOTH baseline and current; this is not recorded as a newly introduced defect. Full-page footer/map samples were also viewed.

minorPolish.finding: The new manual-help button top border directly adjoins the preceding kids link/card border in the captured states. Controls remain separate and there is no text clipping or overlap.
minorPolish.suggestion: Add about 8px vertical spacing in a future intentional design revision if desired.
minorPolish.disposition: Disclosed; no production change was made during this frozen visual review.

toolchain.environment: Local Linux x64, Node24.19.0. Committed visual script uses Turkish locale, fixed date, reduced motion, blocked service workers and its existing bypassCSP screenshot stabilizer. Production-CSP interaction and offline checks are separate evidence.

reproduction.captureArtifacts: Local evidence directory occasion-visual-review contains both complete raw matrices, logs, toolchain proofs and display sheets. Capture hashes and exact observations are retained in this record; the fresh CI run must independently verify its own captured failure set.

scopeLimits: Assistant inspection; neither reviewer is a human approver. The primary reviewer exported the approved imagery and authored an offline test; the supplemental reviewer authored the combo UI. No independent-human approval is claimed.

Default Turkish captured Chromium states at the committed viewports only. Locale interactions, accessibility conformance, physical devices, backend behavior, conversion outcomes and live publication are outside this record.
Long full pages are sampled with overview/top/body/footer views; not every product pixel is reviewed. Display-sheet crop boundaries are diagnostic framing, not claims of page clipping.
The new combo cards are collapsed in this regression matrix; their expanded editor/filters/photography are covered by the separate built-runtime browser suite.

A content-bound record accepts only the complete observed failure set at these exact file blobs and metrics/dimensions. It does not change global thresholds, update baseline images or retroactively turn a failed screenshot comparison into a pass.

reviewGateControls.framework: Unmodified scripts/verify-reviewed-visual-change.mjs, isolated temporary fixture; no production or baseline mutation.
